name: Acme Regional Health
description: Acme Regional Health is a nonprofit hospital system headquartered in Columbus, OH, with roughly 4,200 employees across three acute-care hospitals and a ring of outpatient clinics in central Ohio. Front-desk check-in is still largely paper and clipboard-based, and patient operations leadership is under pressure to cut wait times and registration errors.
